# Torn Exchange

> Torn Exchange (tornexchange.com) is a marketplace for the browser game Torn.
> Players list items and custom services for trade, browse other traders'
> price lists, and complete/track trades with each other.

## Core content

- Home: https://tornexchange.com/ — leaderboards and site overview.
- Trader price lists: https://tornexchange.com/prices/<player-name-or-id> — a
  trader's items for sale, priced against Torn's live market values.
- Trader services: https://tornexchange.com/services/<player-name-or-id> —
  a trader's custom (non-item) offerings, such as reviving or company perks.
- Listings search: https://tornexchange.com/listings — find traders selling
  a specific item.
- About: https://tornexchange.com/about/
- Sitemap: https://tornexchange.com/sitemap.xml
